title: Episode 1
overview: Ai-chan is back, with a special treat to wash away those Monday-morning blues!

title: Episode 2
overview: How would your high school life have been different, if you had a girl with amazing proportions who loved you?

title: Episode 3
overview: Senpai and his junior take a trip down south, but run into overstuffed trouble at the airport!

title: Episode 4
overview: What better way to spend time with your girlfriend than when she's got a sexy swimsuit? But what if that means other men get to look at her too?

title: Episode 5
overview: Take a trip to the farm with Tawawa on Monday, as Ai-chan goes to experience the joy of country living.

title: Episode 6
overview: Sensei's life is about to change forever as he pops the question to his well-endowed former student.

title: Episode 7
overview: A new couple has moved into the apartment complex, and when the wife's bra falls off the clothesline and onto the veranda, it's time to get know them better!

title: Episode 8
overview: Senpai's junior has a secret hobby, and cameras have caught her in the act!

title: Episode 9
overview: It's off to the hot springs, where open-air baths and vibrating massage chairs await! And of course, the ping-pong balls aren't the only thing that bounce!

title: Episode 10
overview: After unfortunately getting him into the papers, the cheerleader has a special way of making it up to her boyfriend.

title: Episode 11
overview: Ai's in big trouble when her bra breaks, and she has to go shopping for a new, bigger one.

title: Episode 12
overview: It's the day of the big wedding, and there are plenty of other big things on display, too!
